title: Insurance stocks mixed as Nifty ends flat; LIC gains 2%
body: Shares of listed insurers ended mixed on Tuesday. Life Insurance Corporation of India rose 2.1%, while HDFC Life Insurance slipped 0.8% and ICICI Prudential Life Insurance closed flat. Analysts at Motilal Oswal said annualised premium equivalent growth for private life insurers moderated to 9% in August. General insurance gross written premium grew 11% year on year, according to data released by the General Insurance Council. Star Health and Niva Bupa were among the health insurers that outperformed the broader index. No transactions were announced during the session.
